newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's central bank to supply $1.0 bln to banks.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's central bank to supply $1.0 bln to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea, South Korea's central bank, said on Saturday it would supply $1.0 billion to commercial banks early next week to ease dollar shortages.
A central bank official said the interest rate on the short-term foreign exchange loans would be 0.25 percentage points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR). There were no further details.
Bankers said overseas borrowing conditions for South Korean banks worsened after Hanbo Steel Co, the nation's second largest steel maker, collapsed in January.
"Some commercial banks have expressed they are experiencing problems getting foreign exchange loans," said the official.
